005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import java.util.HashMap;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.Map;
011import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
012import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
013import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DriverStationJNI;
014import org.wpilib.util.WPIUtilJNI;
015
016/**
017 * Provides access to the Driver Station display.
018 *
019 * <p>Line mode is the default display mode.
020 */
021public final class DriverStationDisplay {
022  private static final long UPDATE_PERIOD_NANOS = 230_000_000L;
023  private static final String CLEAR_DISPLAY = "\033[0m\033[2J\033[H";
024
025  private static final Lock m_displayLock = new ReentrantLock();
026  private static boolean rawMode;
027  private static final Map<String, Integer> lineMap = new HashMap<>();
028  private static final List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
029  private static long lastDisplayUpdate = WPIUtilJNI.now() - UPDATE_PERIOD_NANOS;
030
031  private DriverStationDisplay() {}
032
033  /** Driver Station display mode. */
034  public enum Mode {
035    /** Display line mode. This is the default display mode. */
036    Line,
037
038    /** Raw ANSI text mode. */
039    RawAnsi
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Sets the display mode.
044   *
045   * <p>{@link Mode#Line} is the default display mode. Setting {@link Mode#Line} clears any pending
046   * display lines. Setting {@link Mode#RawAnsi} clears the display.
047   *
048   * @param mode display mode
049   */
050  public static void setMode(Mode mode) {
051    m_displayLock.lock();
052    try {
053      switch (mode) {
054        case Line -> {
055          rawMode = false;
056          lineMap.clear();
057          lines.clear();
058        }
059        case RawAnsi -> {
060          rawMode = true;
061          DriverStationJNI.writeDisplayAnsi(CLEAR_DISPLAY);
062        }
063        default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown display mode: " + mode);
064      }
065    } finally {
066      m_displayLock.unlock();
067    }
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Adds display data in line mode, keyed by an identifier that is not displayed.
072   *
073   * <p>Repeated calls with the same key before {@link #updateLines()} replace the previous line.
074   * The key is used only to identify the line for replacement and is not displayed. Empty or
075   * whitespace-only keys always append a new line.
076   *
077   * @param key Line key.
078   * @param line Line contents.
079   */
080  public static void addKeyedLine(String key, String line) {
081    m_displayLock.lock();
082    try {
083      addKeyedLineUnderLock(key, line);
084    } finally {
085      m_displayLock.unlock();
086    }
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Adds display data in line mode.
091   *
092   * <p>Repeated calls with the same caption before {@link #updateLines()} replace the previous
093   * line. The caption is used to identify the line and is displayed before the line contents,
094   * separated by " : ". Empty or whitespace-only captions always append a new line and are not
095   * displayed.
096   *
097   * @param caption Line caption.
098   * @param line Line contents.
099   */
100  public static void addData(String caption, String line) {
101    String captionText = nonNull(caption);
102    String lineText = nonNull(line);
103
104    if (captionText.isBlank()) {
105      addKeyedLine(captionText, lineText);
106    } else {
107      addKeyedLine(captionText, captionText + " : " + lineText);
108    }
109  }
110
111  /**
112   * Adds display data in line mode.
113   *
114   * <p>Repeated calls with the same caption before {@link #updateLines()} replace the previous
115   * line. The caption is used to identify the line and is displayed before the line contents,
116   * separated by " : ". Empty or whitespace-only captions always append a new line and are not
117   * displayed.
118   *
119   * <p>The value is converted to text with {@link String#valueOf(Object)}.
120   *
121   * @param caption Line caption.
122   * @param value Line value.
123   */
124  public static void addData(String caption, Object value) {
125    addData(caption, String.valueOf(value));
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Adds formatted display data in line mode.
130   *
131   * <p>Repeated calls with the same caption before {@link #updateLines()} replace the previous
132   * line. The caption is used to identify the line and is displayed before the line contents,
133   * separated by " : ". Empty or whitespace-only captions always append a new line and are not
134   * displayed.
135   *
136   * @param caption Line caption.
137   * @param format Format string.
138   * @param args Format arguments.
139   */
140  public static void addData(String caption, String format, Object... args) {
141    addData(caption, String.format(format, args));
142  }
143
144  private static void addKeyedLineUnderLock(String key, String line) {
145    if (rawMode) {
146      return;
147    }
148
149    String keyText = nonNull(key);
150    String lineText = nonNull(line);
151
152    if (keyText.isBlank()) {
153      lines.add(lineText);
154      return;
155    }
156
157    Integer lineNum = lineMap.get(keyText);
158    if (lineNum == null) {
159      lineMap.put(keyText, lines.size());
160      lines.add(lineText);
161    } else if (lineNum < lines.size()) {
162      lines.set(lineNum, lineText);
163    }
164  }
165
166  /**
167   * Adds an uncaptioned display line in line mode.
168   *
169   * <p>This is equivalent to calling {@link #addKeyedLine(String, String)} with an empty key, which
170   * always appends a new line.
171   *
172   * @param line Line contents.
173   */
174  public static void addLine(String line) {
175    addKeyedLine("", line);
176  }
177
178  /**
179   * Updates the display with all pending lines and clears the pending lines.
180   *
181   * <p>Updates are sent at most once every 230 ms. If called before 230 ms has elapsed since the
182   * last update, the pending lines are cleared without sending.
183   */
184  public static void updateLines() {
185    m_displayLock.lock();
186    try {
187      if (rawMode) {
188        return;
189      }
190
191      long now = WPIUtilJNI.now();
192      if (now - lastDisplayUpdate < UPDATE_PERIOD_NANOS) {
193        lineMap.clear();
194        lines.clear();
195        return;
196      }
197      lastDisplayUpdate = now;
198
199      StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
200      builder.append(CLEAR_DISPLAY);
201      for (String line : lines) {
202        builder.append(line).append("\033[0m\n");
203      }
204
205      DriverStationJNI.writeDisplayAnsi(builder.toString());
206
207      lineMap.clear();
208      lines.clear();
209    } finally {
210      m_displayLock.unlock();
211    }
212  }
213
214  /**
215   * Writes ANSI text directly to the display in raw ANSI mode.
216   *
217   * <p>This call is ignored unless the display is in raw ANSI mode.
218   *
219   * @param data ANSI text to write.
220   */
221  public static void writeRawAnsi(String data) {
222    m_displayLock.lock();
223    try {
224      if (rawMode) {
225        DriverStationJNI.writeDisplayAnsi(nonNull(data));
226      }
227    } finally {
228      m_displayLock.unlock();
229    }
230  }
231
232  /**
233   * Clears the display in raw ANSI mode.
234   *
235   * <p>This call is ignored unless the display is in raw ANSI mode.
236   */
237  public static void clearRaw() {
238    m_displayLock.lock();
239    try {
240      if (rawMode) {
241        DriverStationJNI.writeDisplayAnsi(CLEAR_DISPLAY);
242      }
243    } finally {
244      m_displayLock.unlock();
245    }
246  }
247
248  private static String nonNull(String value) {
249    return value == null ? "" : value;
250  }
251}
